# Code of Conduct

This project is for people who run game servers and for people who improve the tool. Discussion stays on the software.

## Expected behavior

- Comment on the change, the log, or the design.
- Accept that a maintainer may decline a change that makes process shutdown less reliable.
- Give newcomers a concrete next step when they ask for help.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Insults, harassment, or personal information posted without consent.
- Requests to use this project against machines or accounts you do not administer.

## Enforcement

The repository owner decides whether an issue, pull request, or comment stays open. Reports can be sent through a private security advisory or by contacting the owner. Reports are kept private except when the reporter asks otherwise.
